In this work, we present an electronics-free, earthworm-inspired pneumatic robot utilizing a modified Pneumatic Logic Gate (PLG) design. By integrating preconfigured PLG units with bellow actuators, we achieved a plug-and-play style modular system capable of peristaltic locomotion without external electronic components. The proposed design reduces system complexity while maintaining efficient actuation. We characterize the bellow actuators under different operating conditions and evaluate the robots locomotion performance. Our findings demonstrate that the modified PLG-based control system effectively generates peristaltic wave propagation, achieving autonomous motion with minimal deviation. This study serves as a proof of concept for the development of electronics-free, peristaltic soft robots. The proposed system has potential for applications in hazardous environments, where untethered, adaptable locomotion is critical. Future work will focus on further optimizing the robot design and exploring untethered operation using onboard compressed air sources.
summary_zh: 软体机器人系统因其固有的灵活性、适应性和安全性而受到广泛关注，使其非常适合各种应用。 在仿生设计中，蚯蚓运动因其高效的蠕动而得到了广泛的研究，使其能够在狭窄和非结构化环境中移动。 现有的蚯蚓机器人主要采用气动驱动，因为其具有较高的力重比和易于实现的特点。 然而，这些系统通常依赖于笨重、耗电的电子控制单元，从而限制了它们的实用性。 在这项工作中，我们提出了一种无需电子器件的、受蚯蚓启发的、采用改进型气动逻辑门（PLG）设计的气动机器人。 通过将预先配置的PLG单元与波纹管致动器集成，我们实现了一种即插即用的模块化系统，该系统能够在没有外部电子元件的情况下进行蠕动。 所提出的设计降低了系统复杂性，同时保持了高效的驱动。 我们对不同工况下的波纹管致动器进行了表征，并评估了机器人的运动性能。 我们的研究结果表明，改进的基于PLG的控制系统有效地产生了蠕动波传播，实现了偏差最小的自主运动。 这项研究为开发无需电子器件的蠕动式软体机器人提供了一个概念验证。 所提出的系统在危险环境中具有应用潜力，在这些环境中，无需连接的自适应运动至关重要。 未来的工作将侧重于进一步优化机器人设计，并探索使用车载压缩空气源的无线操作。
tldr: This paper introduces an electronics-free, earthworm-inspired soft robot that uses modified pneumatic logic gates (PLGs) for peristaltic locomotion, potentially enabling applications in hazardous environments where untethered, adaptable movement is crucial.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种无需电子元件、受蚯蚓启发的软体机器人，该机器人使用改进的气动逻辑门 (PLG) 实现蠕动，从而可能在需要无线、适应性运动的危险环境中使用。

title: A High-Speed Capable Spherical Robot
summary: This paper designs a new spherical robot structure capable of supporting high-speed motion at up to 10 m/s. Building upon a single-pendulum-driven spherical robot, the design incorporates a momentum wheel with an axis aligned with the secondary pendulum, creating a novel spherical robot structure. Practical experiments with the physical prototype have demonstrated that this new spherical robot can achieve stable high-speed motion through simple decoupled control, which was unattainable with the original structure. The spherical robot designed for high-speed motion not only increases speed but also significantly enhances obstacle-crossing performance and terrain robustness.
summary_zh: 本文设计了一种新型球形机器人结构，能够支持高达10米/秒的高速运动。基于单摆驱动球形机器人，该设计引入了一个动量轮，其轴线与次级摆对齐，从而创建了一种新颖的球形机器人结构。物理样机的实际实验表明，这种新型球形机器人可以通过简单的解耦控制实现稳定的高速运动，这在原始结构中是无法实现的。这种为高速运动设计的球形机器人不仅提高了速度，还显著增强了越障性能和地形适应性。
tldr: The paper presents a novel spherical robot design incorporating a momentum wheel for stable high-speed motion (up to 10 m/s), improved obstacle crossing, and better terrain robustness, demonstrated through physical prototype experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新型球形机器人设计，该机器人结合了动量轮，实现了高达10米/秒的稳定高速运动，并改善了越障能力和地形适应性，这些优点已通过物理原型实验得到证实。

title: Improving Needle Penetration via Precise Rotational Insertion Using Iterative Learning Control
summary: Achieving precise control of robotic tool paths is often challenged by inherent system misalignments, unmodeled dynamics, and actuation inaccuracies. This work introduces an Iterative Learning Control (ILC) strategy to enable precise rotational insertion of a tool during robotic surgery, improving penetration efficacy and safety compared to straight insertion tested in subretinal injection. A 4 degree of freedom (DOF) robot manipulator is used, where misalignment of the fourth joint complicates the simple application of needle rotation, motivating an ILC approach that iteratively adjusts joint commands based on positional feedback. The process begins with calibrating the forward kinematics for the chosen surgical tool to achieve higher accuracy, followed by successive ILC iterations guided by Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) volume scans to measure the error and refine control inputs. Experimental results, tested on subretinal injection tasks on ex vivo pig eyes, show that the optimized trajectory resulted in higher success rates in tissue penetration and subretinal injection compared to straight insertion, demonstrating the effectiveness of ILC in overcoming misalignment challenges. This approach offers potential applications for other high precision robot tasks requiring controlled insertions as well.
summary_zh: 实现机器人工具路径的精确控制常常受到固有系统偏差、未建模动力学和驱动不准确等因素的挑战。本研究提出了一种迭代学习控制（ILC）策略，以实现机器人手术中工具的精确旋转插入，与在视网膜下注射中测试的直线插入相比，提高了穿透效果和安全性。使用了一个四自由度（DOF）的机器人机械臂，其中第四个关节的偏差使简单的针旋转应用复杂化，因此采用基于位置反馈迭代调整关节指令的ILC方法。该过程首先校准所选手术工具的正向运动学，以获得更高的精度，然后通过光学相干断层扫描（OCT）体积扫描引导后续的ILC迭代，以测量误差并改进控制输入。在离体猪眼视网膜下注射任务中进行的实验结果表明，与直线插入相比，优化后的轨迹在组织穿透和视网膜下注射中获得了更高的成功率，证明了ILC在克服偏差挑战方面的有效性。这种方法也为其他需要受控插入的高精度机器人任务提供了潜在的应用。
tldr: This paper presents an Iterative Learning Control (ILC) strategy for precise rotational needle insertion during robotic surgery, validated through subretinal injection experiments, demonstrating improved penetration efficacy compared to straight insertion.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种迭代学习控制（ILC）策略，用于机器人手术中精确的旋转针插入。通过视网膜下注射实验验证，与直线插入相比，该策略显示出更高的穿透效率。

title: Saliency-Guided Domain Adaptation for Left-Hand Driving in Autonomous Steering
summary: Domain adaptation is required for automated driving models to generalize well across diverse road conditions. This paper explores a training method for domain adaptation to adapt PilotNet, an end-to-end deep learning-based model, for left-hand driving conditions using real-world Australian highway data. Four training methods were evaluated: (1) a baseline model trained on U.S. right-hand driving data, (2) a model trained on flipped U.S. data, (3) a model pretrained on U.S. data and then fine-tuned on Australian highways, and (4) a model pretrained on flipped U.S. data and then finetuned on Australian highways. This setup examines whether incorporating flipped data enhances the model adaptation by providing an initial left-hand driving alignment. The paper compares model performance regarding steering prediction accuracy and attention, using saliency-based analysis to measure attention shifts across significant road regions. Results show that pretraining on flipped data alone worsens prediction stability due to misaligned feature representations, but significantly improves adaptation when followed by fine-tuning, leading to lower prediction error and stronger focus on left-side cues. To validate this approach across different architectures, the same experiments were done on ResNet, which confirmed similar adaptation trends. These findings emphasize the importance of preprocessing techniques, such as flipped-data pretraining, followed by fine-tuning to improve model adaptation with minimal retraining requirements.
summary_zh: 领域自适应是自动驾驶模型在各种道路条件下良好泛化的必要条件。本文探讨了一种领域自适应训练方法，用于使基于端到端深度学习的模型PilotNet适应左侧驾驶条件，并使用真实的澳大利亚高速公路数据。评估了四种训练方法：（1）在美国右侧驾驶数据上训练的基线模型，（2）在美国翻转数据上训练的模型，（3）在美国数据上预训练并在澳大利亚高速公路上微调的模型，以及（4）在美国翻转数据上预训练并在澳大利亚高速公路上微调的模型。该设置旨在检验通过提供初始的左侧驾驶对齐，整合翻转数据是否能增强模型的自适应能力。本文通过显著性分析来衡量关键道路区域的注意力转移，并比较模型在转向预测精度和注意力方面的性能。结果表明，由于特征表示错位，单独进行翻转数据的预训练会降低预测稳定性，但随后进行微调则会显著提高自适应能力，从而降低预测误差并更强烈地关注左侧线索。为了验证该方法在不同架构中的有效性，还在ResNet上进行了相同的实验，证实了类似的自适应趋势。这些发现强调了诸如翻转数据预训练之类的预处理技术，以及随后进行微调对于以最小的再训练需求来改善模型自适应的重要性。
tldr: This paper explores domain adaptation techniques, specifically using flipped data pretraining and fine-tuning, to improve autonomous steering models for left-hand driving in Australia, demonstrating improved performance and attention to left-side cues. The approach is validated on both PilotNet and ResNet architectures.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了领域自适应技术，特别是使用翻转数据预训练和微调，以改进澳大利亚左侧驾驶的自动驾驶模型，展示了改进的性能和对左侧线索的关注。该方法已在 PilotNet 和 ResNet 架构上得到验证。

title: Tackling the Kidnapped Robot Problem via Sparse Feasible Hypothesis Sampling and Reliable Batched Multi-Stage Inference
summary: This paper addresses the Kidnapped Robot Problem (KRP), a core localization challenge of relocalizing a robot in a known map without prior pose estimate when localization loss or at SLAM initialization. For this purpose, a passive 2-D global relocalization framework is proposed. It estimates the global pose efficiently and reliably from a single LiDAR scan and an occupancy grid map while the robot remains stationary, thereby enhancing the long-term autonomy of mobile robots. The proposed framework casts global relocalization as a non-convex problem and solves it via the multi-hypothesis scheme with batched multi-stage inference and early termination, balancing completeness and efficiency. The Rapidly-exploring Random Tree (RRT), under traversability constraints, asymptotically covers the reachable space to generate sparse, uniformly distributed feasible positional hypotheses, fundamentally reducing the sampling space. The hypotheses are preliminarily ordered by the proposed Scan Mean Absolute Difference (SMAD), a coarse beam-error level metric that facilitates the early termination by prioritizing high-likelihood candidates. The SMAD computation is optimized for limited scan measurements. The Translation-Affinity Scan-to-Map Alignment Metric (TAM) is proposed for reliable orientation selection at hypothesized positions and accurate final global pose evaluation to mitigate degradation in conventional likelihood-field metrics under translational uncertainty induced by sparse hypotheses, as well as non-panoramic LiDAR scan and environmental changes. Real-world experiments on a resource-constrained mobile robot with non-panoramic LiDAR scans show that the proposed framework achieves competitive performance in success rate, robustness under measurement uncertainty, and computational efficiency.
summary_zh: 本文研究了绑架机器人问题（KRP），这是重定位中的一个核心挑战，即在已知地图中重定位机器人，在定位信息丢失或SLAM初始化时，无需先验位姿估计。为此，提出了一种被动的二维全局重定位框架。该框架仅利用单个激光雷达扫描和一个占据栅格地图，高效可靠地估计全局位姿，同时保持机器人静止，从而增强移动机器人的长期自主性。所提出的框架将全局重定位转化为一个非凸问题，并通过具有批处理多阶段推理和提前终止的多假设方案来解决，从而平衡完整性和效率。快速扩展随机树（RRT）在可通行性约束下，渐近覆盖可达空间，生成稀疏、均匀分布的可行位置假设，从根本上减少了采样空间。这些假设通过提出的扫描平均绝对差（SMAD）进行初步排序，SMAD是一种粗略的光束误差级别度量，通过优先考虑高似然候选者来促进提前终止。针对有限的扫描测量数据，对SMAD的计算进行了优化。提出了平移亲和力扫描到地图对齐度量（TAM），用于在假设位置进行可靠的方向选择和精确的最终全局位姿评估，以减轻由稀疏假设引起的平移不确定性以及非全景激光雷达扫描和环境变化导致的传统似然场度量的性能下降。在使用非全景激光雷达扫描仪的资源受限的移动机器人上进行的真实世界实验表明，所提出的框架在成功率、测量不确定性下的鲁棒性和计算效率方面都取得了具有竞争力的性能。
tldr: This paper presents a framework for global robot relocalization using LiDAR scans and occupancy grid maps, addressing the Kidnapped Robot Problem with a sparse hypothesis sampling and multi-stage inference approach to improve efficiency and robustness.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种使用激光雷达扫描和栅格地图进行全局机器人重定位的框架，通过稀疏假设采样和多阶段推理来解决绑架机器人问题，从而提高效率和鲁棒性。

title: Wonder3D++: Cross-domain Diffusion for High-fidelity 3D Generation from a Single Image
summary: In this work, we introduce \textbf{Wonder3D++}, a novel method for efficiently generating high-fidelity textured meshes from single-view images. Recent methods based on Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) have shown the potential to recover 3D geometry from 2D diffusion priors, but they typically suffer from time-consuming per-shape optimization and inconsistent geometry. In contrast, certain works directly produce 3D information via fast network inferences, but their results are often of low quality and lack geometric details. To holistically improve the quality, consistency, and efficiency of single-view reconstruction tasks, we propose a cross-domain diffusion model that generates multi-view normal maps and the corresponding color images. To ensure the consistency of generation, we employ a multi-view cross-domain attention mechanism that facilitates information exchange across views and modalities. Lastly, we introduce a cascaded 3D mesh extraction algorithm that drives high-quality surfaces from the multi-view 2D representations in only about $3$ minute in a coarse-to-fine manner. Our extensive evaluations demonstrate that our method achieves high-quality reconstruction results, robust generalization, and good efficiency compared to prior works. Code available at https://github.com/xxlong0/Wonder3D/tree/Wonder3D_Plus.
summary_zh: 在这项工作中，我们介绍了一种名为\textbf{Wonder3D++}的新颖方法，用于从单视角图像高效地生成高保真度的纹理网格。最近基于分数蒸馏采样(SDS)的方法已经展现出从二维扩散先验中恢复三维几何的潜力，但它们通常受到耗时的逐形状优化和不一致几何的困扰。相比之下，某些工作通过快速网络推断直接生成三维信息，但它们的结果通常质量较低，缺乏几何细节。为全面提高单视角重建任务的质量、一致性和效率，我们提出了一种跨域扩散模型，用于生成多视角法线贴图和对应的彩色图像。为确保生成的一致性，我们采用了一种多视角跨域注意力机制，促进跨视角和模态的信息交换。最后，我们引入了一种级联三维网格提取算法，以粗到精的方式，大约在3分钟内从多视角二维表示中驱动高质量的表面。我们大量的评估表明，与先前的工作相比，我们的方法实现了高质量的重建结果、稳健的泛化能力以及良好的效率。代码可在https://github.com/xxlong0/Wonder3D/tree/Wonder3D_Plus获取。
tldr: Wonder3D++ introduces a cross-domain diffusion model for high-fidelity, efficient 3D mesh generation from a single image by generating multi-view normal maps and color images, achieving improved quality, consistency and speed.
tldr_zh: Wonder3D++ 提出了一种跨域扩散模型，通过生成多视图法线图和彩色图像，从单张图像高效生成高保真 3D 网格，从而提高质量、一致性和速度。

title: Real-time Continual Learning on Intel Loihi 2
summary: AI systems on edge devices face a critical challenge in open-world environments: adapting when data distributions shift and novel classes emerge. While offline training dominates current paradigms, online continual learning (OCL)--where models learn incrementally from non-stationary streams without catastrophic forgetting--remains challenging in power-constrained settings. We present a neuromorphic solution called CLP-SNN: a spiking neural network architecture for Continually Learning Prototypes and its implementation on Intel's Loihi 2 chip. Our approach introduces three innovations: (1) event-driven and spatiotemporally sparse local learning, (2) a self-normalizing three-factor learning rule maintaining weight normalization, and (3) integrated neurogenesis and metaplasticity for capacity expansion and forgetting mitigation. On OpenLORIS few-shot learning experiments, CLP-SNN achieves accuracy competitive with replay methods while being rehearsal-free. CLP-SNN delivers transformative efficiency gains: 70\times faster (0.33ms vs 23.2ms), and 5,600\times more energy efficient (0.05mJ vs 281mJ) than the best alternative OCL on edge GPU. This demonstrates that co-designed brain-inspired algorithms and neuromorphic hardware can break traditional accuracy-efficiency trade-offs for future edge AI systems.
summary_zh: 边缘设备上的人工智能系统在开放世界环境中面临着一个关键挑战：当数据分布发生变化和新类别出现时进行适应。 虽然离线训练在目前的范式中占据主导地位，但在线持续学习 (OCL)——模型从非平稳数据流中增量学习而不发生灾难性遗忘——在功耗受限的环境中仍然具有挑战性。 我们提出了一种神经形态解决方案，称为 CLP-SNN：一种用于持续学习原型Spiking神经网络架构，并在 Intel 的 Loihi 2 芯片上实现。 我们的方法引入了三个创新：（1）事件驱动和时空稀疏的局部学习，（2）一种维持权重归一化的自归一化三因子学习规则，以及（3）用于容量扩展和遗忘缓解的集成神经发生和元可塑性。 在 OpenLORIS 小样本学习实验中，CLP-SNN 实现了与重放方法相当的准确率，同时无需任何排练数据。 CLP-SNN 实现了变革性的效率提升：比边缘 GPU 上最佳的替代 OCL 方法快 70 倍（0.33 毫秒 vs 23.2 毫秒），能效高 5,600 倍（0.05 毫焦耳 vs 281 毫焦耳）。 这表明，协同设计的受大脑启发算法和神经形态硬件可以打破未来边缘人工智能系统的传统准确率与效率之间的权衡。
tldr: This paper presents CLP-SNN, a neuromorphic spiking neural network for online continual learning on Intel's Loihi 2 chip, achieving significant speed and energy efficiency improvements compared to existing OCL methods on edge GPUs in few-shot learning tasks.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于英特尔Loihi 2芯片上的在线持续学习的神经形态脉冲神经网络CLP-SNN，在少样本学习任务中，与边缘GPU上现有的OCL方法相比，实现了显着的运行速度和能源效率提升。

title: OmniFuser: Adaptive Multimodal Fusion for Service-Oriented Predictive Maintenance
summary: Accurate and timely prediction of tool conditions is critical for intelligent manufacturing systems, where unplanned tool failures can lead to quality degradation and production downtime. In modern industrial environments, predictive maintenance is increasingly implemented as an intelligent service that integrates sensing, analysis, and decision support across production processes. To meet the demand for reliable and service-oriented operation, we present OmniFuser, a multimodal learning framework for predictive maintenance of milling tools that leverages both visual and sensor data. It performs parallel feature extraction from high-resolution tool images and cutting-force signals, capturing complementary spatiotemporal patterns across modalities. To effectively integrate heterogeneous features, OmniFuser employs a contamination-free cross-modal fusion mechanism that disentangles shared and modality-specific components, allowing for efficient cross-modal interaction. Furthermore, a recursive refinement pathway functions as an anchor mechanism, consistently retaining residual information to stabilize fusion dynamics. The learned representations can be encapsulated as reusable maintenance service modules, supporting both tool-state classification (e.g., Sharp, Used, Dulled) and multi-step force signal forecasting. Experiments on real-world milling datasets demonstrate that OmniFuser consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, providing a dependable foundation for building intelligent industrial maintenance services.
summary_zh: 刀具状态的准确和及时预测对于智能制造系统至关重要，因为计划外的刀具故障会导致质量下降和生产停机。在现代工业环境中，预测性维护正日益被实施为一种智能服务，它整合了生产过程中的感知、分析和决策支持。为了满足可靠且面向服务的操作需求，我们提出了一种名为OmniFuser的多模态学习框架，用于铣削刀具的预测性维护，该框架利用了视觉和传感器数据。它并行地从高分辨率刀具图像和切削力信号中提取特征，捕捉跨模态的互补时空模式。为了有效地整合异构特征，OmniFuser采用了一种无污染跨模态融合机制，该机制解耦了共享和模态特定的成分，从而实现了高效的跨模态交互。此外，递归细化路径用作锚定机制，持续保留残差信息以稳定融合动态。学习到的表征可以被封装为可重用的维护服务模块，支持刀具状态分类（例如，锋利、已用、钝化）和多步力信号预测。在真实世界铣削数据集上的实验表明，OmniFuser始终优于最先进的基线方法，为构建智能工业维护服务提供了可靠的基础。
tldr: The paper presents OmniFuser, a multimodal learning framework for predictive maintenance of milling tools using visual and sensor data with a contamination-free cross-modal fusion mechanism and recursive refinement pathway. It outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on real-world datasets.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了OmniFuser，一个用于铣削工具预测性维护的多模态学习框架，它使用视觉和传感器数据，具有无污染的跨模态融合机制和递归细化路径。在真实世界数据集上，该方法优于最先进的基线方法。

title: HGFreNet: Hop-hybrid GraphFomer for 3D Human Pose Estimation with Trajectory Consistency in Frequency Domain
summary: 2D-to-3D human pose lifting is a fundamental challenge for 3D human pose estimation in monocular video, where graph convolutional networks (GCNs) and attention mechanisms have proven to be inherently suitable for encoding the spatial-temporal correlations of skeletal joints. However, depth ambiguity and errors in 2D pose estimation lead to incoherence in the 3D trajectory. Previous studies have attempted to restrict jitters in the time domain, for instance, by constraining the differences between adjacent frames while neglecting the global spatial-temporal correlations of skeletal joint motion. To tackle this problem, we design HGFreNet, a novel GraphFormer architecture with hop-hybrid feature aggregation and 3D trajectory consistency in the frequency domain. Specifically, we propose a hop-hybrid graph attention (HGA) module and a Transformer encoder to model global joint spatial-temporal correlations. The HGA module groups all $k$-hop neighbors of a skeletal joint into a hybrid group to enlarge the receptive field and applies the attention mechanism to discover the latent correlations of these groups globally. We then exploit global temporal correlations by constraining trajectory consistency in the frequency domain. To provide 3D information for depth inference across frames and maintain coherence over time, a preliminary network is applied to estimate the 3D pose. Extensive experiments were conducted on two standard benchmark datasets: Human3.6M and MPI-INF-3DHP. The results demonstrate that the proposed HGFreNet outperforms state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods in terms of positional accuracy and temporal consistency.
summary_zh: 单目视频中的2D到3D人体姿态提升是3D人体姿态估计的一项基础挑战，图中卷积网络（GCNs）和注意力机制已被证明非常适合编码骨骼关节的时空相关性。然而，深度歧义和2D姿态估计中的误差导致3D轨迹的不连贯。以往的研究试图限制时域中的抖动，例如，通过约束相邻帧之间的差异，而忽略了骨骼关节运动的全局时空相关性。为了解决这个问题，我们设计了HGFreNet，一种新颖的GraphFormer架构，具有跳跃混合特征聚合和频域中的3D轨迹一致性。具体而言，我们提出了一个跳跃混合图注意力（HGA）模块和一个Transformer编码器来建模全局关节时空相关性。 HGA模块将骨骼关节的所有$k$-hop邻居分组到一个混合组中，以扩大感受野，并应用注意力机制来全局发现这些组的潜在相关性。然后，我们通过约束频域中的轨迹一致性来利用全局时间相关性。为了为跨帧的深度推断提供3D信息并保持时间上的一致性，我们应用了一个初步网络来估计3D姿态。 在两个标准基准数据集Human3.6M和MPI-INF-3DHP上进行了广泛的实验。 实验结果表明，所提出的HGFreNet在位置精度和时间一致性方面均优于最先进（SOTA）的方法。
tldr: The paper introduces HGFreNet, a GraphFormer architecture for 3D human pose estimation from monocular video, which employs hop-hybrid feature aggregation and frequency domain trajectory consistency to improve accuracy and temporal coherence.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种名为HGFreNet的GraphFormer架构，用于从单目视频中进行3D人体姿势估计。该架构采用跳跃混合特征聚合和频域轨迹一致性来提高准确性和时间相干性。

title: Toward Strategy Identification and Subtask Decomposition In Task Exploration
summary: This research builds on work in anticipatory human-machine interaction, a subfield of human-machine interaction where machines can facilitate advantageous interactions by anticipating a user's future state. The aim of this research is to further a machine's understanding of user knowledge, skill, and behavior in pursuit of implicit coordination. A task explorer pipeline was developed that uses clustering techniques, paired with factor analysis and string edit distance, to automatically identify key global and local strategies that are used to complete tasks. Global strategies identify generalized sets of actions used to complete tasks, while local strategies identify sequences that used those sets of actions in a similar composition. Additionally, meaningful subtasks of various lengths are identified within the tasks. The task explorer pipeline was able to automatically identify key strategies used to complete tasks and encode user runs with hierarchical subtask structures. In addition, a Task Explorer application was developed to easily review pipeline results. The task explorer pipeline can be easily modified to any action-based time-series data and the identified strategies and subtasks help to inform humans and machines on user knowledge, skill, and behavior.
summary_zh: 本研究基于预期性人机交互领域的工作，此人机交互子领域旨在通过机器预测用户的未来状态来促进有利的交互。 本研究的目标是加深机器对用户知识、技能和行为的理解，以实现隐性协调。 开发了一个任务探索器流程，它结合了聚类技术，以及因子分析和字符串编辑距离，来自动识别用于完成任务的关键全局和局部策略。 全局策略识别用于完成任务的广义动作集合，而局部策略识别以相似组合方式使用这些动作集合的序列。 此外，还识别了任务中各种长度的有意义的子任务。 任务探索器流程能够自动识别用于完成任务的关键策略，并以分层子任务结构编码用户操作轨迹。 此外，还开发了一个任务探索器应用程序，以方便地审查流程结果。 任务探索器流程可以很容易地修改以应用于任何基于动作的时间序列数据，并且识别出的策略和子任务有助于告知人类和机器关于用户的知识、技能和行为。
tldr: The paper introduces a task explorer pipeline that automatically identifies key global and local strategies and subtasks in action-based time-series data to understand user knowledge, skill, and behavior for anticipatory human-machine interaction.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个任务探索管道，可以自动识别基于动作的时间序列数据中的关键全局和局部策略以及子任务，从而理解用户的知识、技能和行为，以用于预测性人机交互。

title: MVSMamba: Multi-View Stereo with State Space Model
summary: Robust feature representations are essential for learning-based Multi-View Stereo (MVS), which relies on accurate feature matching. Recent MVS methods leverage Transformers to capture long-range dependencies based on local features extracted by conventional feature pyramid networks. However, the quadratic complexity of Transformer-based MVS methods poses challenges to balance performance and efficiency. Motivated by the global modeling capability and linear complexity of the Mamba architecture, we propose MVSMamba, the first Mamba-based MVS network. MVSMamba enables efficient global feature aggregation with minimal computational overhead. To fully exploit Mamba's potential in MVS, we propose a Dynamic Mamba module (DM-module) based on a novel reference-centered dynamic scanning strategy, which enables: (1) Efficient intra- and inter-view feature interaction from the reference to source views, (2) Omnidirectional multi-view feature representations, and (3) Multi-scale global feature aggregation. Extensive experimental results demonstrate MVSMamba outperforms state-of-the-art MVS methods on the DTU dataset and the Tanks-and-Temples benchmark with both superior performance and efficiency. The source code is available at https://github.com/JianfeiJ/MVSMamba.
summary_zh: 鲁棒的特征表示对于基于学习的多视角立体视觉 (MVS) 至关重要，它依赖于精确的特征匹配。最近的MVS方法利用Transformer来捕获基于传统特征金字塔网络提取的局部特征的长程依赖关系。然而，基于Transformer的MVS方法的二次复杂度对平衡性能和效率提出了挑战。受Mamba架构的全局建模能力和线性复杂度的启发，我们提出了MVSMamba，第一个基于Mamba的MVS网络。MVSMamba以最小的计算开销实现了高效的全局特征聚合。为了充分挖掘Mamba在MVS中的潜力，我们提出了一种基于新型参考中心动态扫描策略的动态Mamba模块（DM-module），该模块能够实现：（1）从参考视图到源视图的高效的视图内和视图间特征交互；（2）全向多视图特征表示；（3）多尺度全局特征聚合。大量的实验结果表明，MVSMamba在DTU数据集和Tanks-and-Temples基准测试中优于最先进的MVS方法，同时具有卓越的性能和效率。源代码可在https://github.com/JianfeiJ/MVSMamba获取。
tldr: The paper introduces MVSMamba, a novel Multi-View Stereo network leveraging the Mamba architecture for efficient global feature aggregation outperforming state-of-the-art methods in performance and efficiency. It uses a Dynamic Mamba module for improved feature interaction and representation.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 MVSMamba，一种新的多视图立体网络，利用 Mamba 架构实现高效的全局特征聚合，并在性能和效率上优于最先进的方法。它使用动态 Mamba 模块来改进特征交互和表示。

title: Source-Only Cross-Weather LiDAR via Geometry-Aware Point Drop
summary: LiDAR semantic segmentation degrades in adverse weather because refraction, scattering, and point dropouts corrupt geometry. Prior work in weather simulation, mixing-based augmentation, domain randomization, and uncertainty or boundary regularization improves robustness but still overlooks structural vulnerabilities near boundaries, corners, and sparse regions. We present a Light Geometry-aware adapter. The module aligns azimuth and applies horizontal circular padding to preserve neighbor continuity across the 0~360 degree wrap-around boundary. A local-window K-Nearest Neighbors gathers nearby points and computes simple local statistics, which are compressed into compact geometry-aware cues. During training, these cues drive region-aware regularization that stabilizes predictions in structurally fragile areas. The adapter is plug and play, complements augmentation, and can be enabled only during training with negligible inference cost. We adopt a source-only cross-weather setup where models train on SemanticKITTI and are evaluated on SemanticSTF without target labels or fine-tuning. The adapter improves mIoU by 7.9 percentage points over the data-centric augmentation baseline and by 0.6 points over the class-centric regularization baseline. These results indicate that geometry-driven regularization is a key direction for all-weather LiDAR segmentation.
summary_zh: 激光雷达语义分割在恶劣天气下性能下降，因为折射、散射和点云缺失破坏了几何结构。先前在天气模拟、基于混合的增强、领域随机化以及不确定性或边界正则化方面的工作提高了鲁棒性，但仍然忽略了边界、角落和稀疏区域附近的结构脆弱性。我们提出了一种轻量级的几何感知适配器。该模块对齐方位角并应用水平圆形填充以保持0~360度环绕边界上的邻域连续性。局部窗口的K近邻算法收集附近的点并计算简单的局部统计量，这些统计量被压缩成紧凑的几何感知线索。在训练期间，这些线索驱动区域感知正则化，从而稳定结构脆弱区域的预测。该适配器是即插即用的，补充了数据增强，并且可以仅在训练期间启用，推理成本可忽略不计。我们采用一种仅源域的跨天气设置，模型在SemanticKITTI上训练，并在没有目标标签或微调的情况下在SemanticSTF上评估。该适配器比以数据为中心的增强基线提高了7.9个百分点的mIoU，比以类别为中心的正则化基线提高了0.6个百分点。这些结果表明，几何驱动的正则化是全天候激光雷达分割的关键方向。
tldr: This paper introduces a geometry-aware adapter for LiDAR semantic segmentation to improve robustness in adverse weather, particularly focusing on structural vulnerabilities. It trains on one dataset and evaluates on another without fine-tuning, achieving improved mean Intersection over Union via a region-aware regularization approach.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种用于激光雷达语义分割的几何感知适配器，旨在提高在恶劣天气下的鲁棒性，特别关注结构脆弱性。 它在一个数据集上训练，并在另一个数据集上评估，无需微调，并通过区域感知正则化方法实现了改进的平均交并比。

title: Towards Reliable Human Evaluations in Gesture Generation: Insights from a Community-Driven State-of-the-Art Benchmark
summary: We review human evaluation practices in automated, speech-driven 3D gesture generation and find a lack of standardisation and frequent use of flawed experimental setups. This leads to a situation where it is impossible to know how different methods compare, or what the state of the art is. In order to address common shortcomings of evaluation design, and to standardise future user studies in gesture-generation works, we introduce a detailed human evaluation protocol for the widely-used BEAT2 motion-capture dataset. Using this protocol, we conduct large-scale crowdsourced evaluation to rank six recent gesture-generation models -- each trained by its original authors -- across two key evaluation dimensions: motion realism and speech-gesture alignment. Our results provide strong evidence that 1) newer models do not consistently outperform earlier approaches; 2) published claims of high motion realism or speech-gesture alignment may not hold up under rigorous evaluation; and 3) the field must adopt disentangled assessments of motion quality and multimodal alignment for accurate benchmarking in order to make progress. Finally, in order to drive standardisation and enable new evaluation research, we will release five hours of synthetic motion from the benchmarked models; over 750 rendered video stimuli from the user studies -- enabling new evaluations without model reimplementation required -- alongside our open-source rendering script, and the 16,000 pairwise human preference votes collected for our benchmark.
summary_zh: 我们回顾了在自动、语音驱动的3D手势生成中的人工评估实践，并发现缺乏标准化以及频繁使用有缺陷的实验设置。这导致无法得知不同方法之间的比较情况，也无法得知当前最佳水平。为了解决评估设计的常见缺陷，并标准化未来手势生成工作中的用户研究，我们为广泛使用的BEAT2动作捕捉数据集引入了一个详细的人工评估协议。利用这个协议，我们进行了大规模的众包评估，以对六个最新的手势生成模型（每个模型都由其原始作者训练）在两个关键评估维度上进行排名：动作真实性和语音-手势对齐。我们的结果提供了强有力的证据，表明：1) 较新的模型并不总是优于早期的方法；2) 已发表的高动作真实性或语音-手势对齐的声明可能无法通过严格的评估；以及3) 为了取得进展，该领域必须采用对动作质量和多模态对齐的解耦评估方法进行准确的基准测试。最后，为了推动标准化并支持新的评估研究，我们将发布来自被测试模型的五个小时的合成动作；来自用户研究的超过750个渲染的视频刺激（无需重新实现模型即可进行新的评估），以及我们的开源渲染脚本，以及为我们的基准收集的16000个成对人类偏好投票。
tldr: The paper identifies flaws in human evaluation practices for speech-driven gesture generation and proposes a standardized evaluation protocol with a large-scale benchmark, finding inconsistencies in published results and advocating for disentangled assessments.
tldr_zh: 该论文指出了语音驱动手势生成中人为评估实践的缺陷，并提出了一个标准化的评估协议和一个大规模的基准测试，发现已发表结果中的不一致性，并提倡对手势质量和多模态对齐进行分离评估。

title: Thermo-responsive closing and reopening artificial Venus Flytrap utilizing shape memory elastomers
summary: Despite their often perceived static and slow nature, some plants can move faster than the blink of an eye. The rapid snap closure motion of the Venus flytrap (Dionaea muscipula) has long captivated the interest of researchers and engineers alike, serving as a model for plant-inspired soft machines and robots. The translation of the fast snapping closure has inspired the development of various artificial Venus flytrap (AVF) systems. However, translating both the closing and reopening motion of D. muscipula into an autonomous plant inspired soft machine has yet to be achieved. In this study, we present an AVF that autonomously closes and reopens, utilizing novel thermo-responsive UV-curable shape memory materials for soft robotic systems. The life-sized thermo-responsive AVF exhibits closing and reopening motions triggered in a naturally occurring temperature range. The doubly curved trap lobes, built from shape memory polymers, close at 38°C, while reopening initiates around 45°C, employing shape memory elastomer strips as antagonistic actuators to facilitate lobe reopening. This work represents the first demonstration of thermo-responsive closing and reopening in an AVF with programmed sequential motion in response to increasing temperature. This approach marks the next step toward autonomously bidirectional moving soft machines/robots.
summary_zh: 尽管植物通常被认为具有静态和缓慢的特性，但有些植物的运动速度比眨眼还快。维纳斯捕蝇草（Dionaea muscipula）的快速闭合运动长期以来吸引了研究人员和工程师的兴趣，并成为植物启发式软体机器和机器人的模型。对快速闭合运动的转化已经激发了各种人工维纳斯捕蝇草（AVF）系统的开发。然而，将捕蝇草的闭合和重新打开运动都转化为自主的植物启发式软体机器尚未实现。在本研究中，我们提出了一种能够自主闭合和重新打开的AVF，该AVF利用新型热响应型紫外光固化形状记忆材料来构建软体机器人系统。这种真人大小的热响应型AVF在自然发生的温度范围内表现出闭合和重新打开的运动。由形状记忆聚合物制成的双曲面陷阱瓣在38°C时闭合，而重新打开则在45°C左右开始，使用形状记忆弹性体条作为拮抗致动器来促进陷阱瓣的重新打开。这项工作首次展示了在AVF中通过可编程的连续运动响应于温度升高而实现的热响应闭合和重新打开。这种方法标志着向自主双向运动软体机器/机器人迈出了下一步。
tldr: This paper presents a novel artificial Venus flytrap (AVF) that autonomously closes and reopens using thermo-responsive shape memory polymers, demonstrating bidirectional motion in a soft robot.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种新型人工维纳斯捕蝇草（AVF），它使用热响应形状记忆聚合物自动关闭和重新打开，展示了软体机器人的双向运动。

title: High-Precision Surgical Robotic System for Intraocular Procedures
summary: Despite the extensive demonstration of robotic systems for both cataract and vitreoretinal procedures, existing technologies or mechanisms still possess insufficient accuracy, precision, and degrees of freedom for instrument manipulation or potentially automated tool exchange during surgical procedures. A new robotic system that focuses on improving tooltip accuracy, tracking performance, and smooth instrument exchange mechanism is therefore designed and manufactured. Its tooltip accuracy, precision, and mechanical capability of maintaining small incision through remote center of motion were externally evaluated using an optical coherence tomography (OCT) system. Through robot calibration and precise coordinate registration, the accuracy of tooltip positioning was measured to be 0.053$\pm$0.031 mm, and the overall performance was demonstrated on an OCT-guided automated cataract lens extraction procedure with deep learning-based pre-operative anatomical modeling and real-time supervision.
summary_zh: 尽管已广泛展示了用于白内障和玻璃体视网膜手术的机器人系统，但现有技术或机制仍然存在精度、精确度和器械操作自由度不足的问题，也难以在手术过程中进行潜在的自动化工具交换。因此，设计并制造了一种新型机器人系统，专注于提高工具尖端的准确性、跟踪性能和流畅的器械交换机制。利用光学相干断层扫描（OCT）系统，对该系统通过远程运动中心保持小切口的工具尖端准确性、精度和机械能力进行了外部评估。通过机器人校准和精确的坐标配准，工具尖端定位的准确性经测量为0.053$\pm$0.031毫米，并通过基于深度学习的术前解剖建模和实时监督的OCT引导的自动化白内障晶状体摘除手术演示了该系统的总体性能。
tldr: The paper presents a new surgical robotic system for intraocular procedures with improved accuracy and an automated tool exchange mechanism, validated through OCT imaging and automated cataract lens extraction.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种新型眼内手术机器人系统，该系统具有更高的精度和自动工具交换机制，并通过OCT成像和自动白内障晶状体取出术进行了验证。

title: Closed-loop Control of Steerable Balloon Endoscopes for Robot-assisted Transcatheter Intracardiac Procedures
summary: To move away from open-heart surgery towards safer transcatheter procedures, there is a growing need for improved imaging techniques and robotic solutions to enable simple, accurate tool navigation. Common imaging modalities, such as fluoroscopy and ultrasound, have limitations that can be overcome using cardioscopy, i.e., direct optical visualization inside the beating heart. We present a cardioscope designed as a steerable balloon. As a balloon, it can be collapsed to pass through the vasculature and subsequently inflated inside the heart for visualization and tool delivery through an integrated working channel. Through careful design of balloon wall thickness, a single input, balloon inflation pressure, is used to independently control two outputs, balloon diameter (corresponding to field of view diameter) and balloon bending angle (enabling precise working channel positioning). This balloon technology can be tuned to produce cardioscopes designed for a range of intracardiac tasks. To illustrate this approach, a balloon design is presented for the specific task of aortic leaflet laceration. Image-based closed-loop control of bending angle is also demonstrated as a means of enabling stable orientation control during tool insertion and removal.
summary_zh: 为了摆脱传统开胸手术，转向更安全的经导管手术，人们越来越需要改进的成像技术和机器人解决方案，以实现简单、精准的工具导航。常用的成像方式，如X射线透视和超声，存在一些局限性，而心内窥镜检查，即在跳动的心脏内部进行直接光学可视化，可以克服这些局限性。我们提出了一种设计为可控弯曲球囊的心内窥镜。该球囊可以收缩以通过血管，随后在心脏内部膨胀，用于可视化和通过集成的操作通道进行工具输送。通过精心设计球囊壁厚度，只需一个输入量，即球囊充气压力，就可以独立控制两个输出量，即球囊直径（对应于视野直径）和球囊弯曲角度（实现精确的操作通道定位）。这种球囊技术可以进行调整，以生产适用于各种心内任务的心内窥镜。为了说明这种方法，我们提出了一种针对主动脉瓣叶撕裂特定任务的球囊设计。还演示了基于图像的弯曲角度闭环控制，作为在工具插入和移除过程中实现稳定方向控制的手段。
tldr: This paper presents a steerable balloon endoscope for robot-assisted transcatheter intracardiac procedures, using balloon pressure to control field of view and bending angle, with closed-loop control demonstrated for stable orientation during tool manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于机器人辅助经导管心内手术的可操纵气球内窥镜，利用气球压力来控制视野和弯曲角度，并演示了闭环控制以在工具操作期间实现稳定的方向控制。

title: The Ghost in the Keys: A Disklavier Demo for Human-AI Musical Co-Creativity
summary: While generative models for music composition are increasingly capable, their adoption by musicians is hindered by text-prompting, an asynchronous workflow disconnected from the embodied, responsive nature of instrumental performance. To address this, we introduce Aria-Duet, an interactive system facilitating a real-time musical duet between a human pianist and Aria, a state-of-the-art generative model, using a Yamaha Disklavier as a shared physical interface. The framework enables a turn-taking collaboration: the user performs, signals a handover, and the model generates a coherent continuation performed acoustically on the piano. Beyond describing the technical architecture enabling this low-latency interaction, we analyze the system's output from a musicological perspective, finding the model can maintain stylistic semantics and develop coherent phrasal ideas, demonstrating that such embodied systems can engage in musically sophisticated dialogue and open a promising new path for human-AI co-creation.
summary_zh: 虽然用于音乐创作的生成模型能力日益增强，但文本提示这种异步工作流程与乐器演奏具身和响应性的本质脱节，阻碍了音乐家对这些模型的采用。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了Aria-Duet，一个交互式系统，它利用雅马哈Disklavier作为共享物理接口，促进人类钢琴家和一种先进的生成模型Aria之间的实时音乐二重奏。该框架实现了轮流协作：用户演奏，发出交接信号，然后模型生成一个连贯的延续，并通过钢琴以原声方式演奏出来。除了描述实现这种低延迟交互的技术架构外，我们还从音乐学的角度分析了系统的输出，发现该模型可以保持风格语义并发展连贯的乐句思想，这表明这种具身系统可以参与音乐上复杂精妙的对话，并为人类-人工智能协同创作开辟一条充满希望的新途径。
tldr: The paper introduces Aria-Duet, an interactive system enabling real-time musical duets between a human pianist and a generative model using a Disklavier, demonstrating musically sophisticated dialogue.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一个名为Aria-Duet的交互系统，它使用Disklavier实现了人类钢琴家和生成模型之间的实时音乐二重奏，展示了音乐上复杂的对话能力。

title: Semantic BIM enrichment for firefighting assets: Fire-ART dataset and panoramic image-based 3D reconstruction
summary: Inventory management of firefighting assets is crucial for emergency preparedness, risk assessment, and on-site fire response. However, conventional methods are inefficient due to limited capabilities in automated asset recognition and reconstruction. To address the challenge, this research introduces the Fire-ART dataset and develops a panoramic image-based reconstruction approach for semantic enrichment of firefighting assets into BIM models. The Fire-ART dataset covers 15 fundamental assets, comprising 2,626 images and 6,627 instances, making it an extensive and publicly accessible dataset for asset recognition. In addition, the reconstruction approach integrates modified cube-map conversion and radius-based spherical camera projection to enhance recognition and localization accuracy. Through validations with two real-world case studies, the proposed approach achieves F1-scores of 73% and 88% and localization errors of 0.620 and 0.428 meters, respectively. The Fire-ART dataset and the reconstruction approach offer valuable resources and robust technical solutions to enhance the accurate digital management of fire safety equipment.
summary_zh: 消防资产的库存管理对于应急准备、风险评估和现场消防至关重要。然而，由于在自动资产识别和重建方面的能力有限，传统方法效率低下。为了解决这一挑战，本研究引入了Fire-ART数据集，并开发了一种基于全景图像的重建方法，用于将消防资产的语义信息丰富到BIM模型中。Fire-ART数据集涵盖15种基本资产，包含2,626张图像和6,627个实例，使其成为一个广泛且公开可用的资产识别数据集。此外，该重建方法集成了改进的立方体贴图转换和基于半径的球面相机投影，以提高识别和定位精度。通过两个真实案例研究的验证，所提出的方法分别实现了73%和88%的F1分数以及0.620和0.428米的定位误差。Fire-ART数据集和重建方法为增强消防安全设备的精确数字化管理提供了宝贵的资源和稳健的技术解决方案。
tldr: This paper introduces the Fire-ART dataset and a panoramic image-based 3D reconstruction method for semantic enrichment of firefighting assets into BIM models, demonstrating promising results in real-world case studies.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了Fire-ART数据集和一种基于全景图像的3D重建方法，用于将消防资产进行语义丰富并整合到BIM模型中，并在实际案例研究中展示了有希望的结果。

title: Koopman-based Prediction of Connectivity for Flying Ad Hoc Networks
summary: The application of machine learning (ML) to communication systems is expected to play a pivotal role in future artificial intelligence (AI)-based next-generation wireless networks. While most existing works focus on ML techniques for static wireless environments, they often face limitations when applied to highly dynamic environments, such as flying ad hoc networks (FANETs). This paper explores the use of data-driven Koopman approaches to address these challenges. Specifically, we investigate how these approaches can model UAV trajectory dynamics within FANETs, enabling more accurate predictions and improved network performance. By leveraging Koopman operator theory, we propose two possible approaches -- centralized and distributed -- to efficiently address the challenges posed by the constantly changing topology of FANETs. To demonstrate this, we consider a FANET performing surveillance with UAVs following pre-determined trajectories and predict signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratios (SINRs) to ensure reliable communication between UAVs. Our results show that these approaches can accurately predict connectivity and isolation events that lead to modelled communication outages. This capability could help UAVs schedule their transmissions based on these predictions.
summary_zh: 机器学习 (ML) 在通信系统中的应用有望在未来基于人工智能 (AI) 的下一代无线网络中发挥关键作用。虽然大多数现有工作侧重于静态无线环境下的 ML 技术，但当应用于高度动态的环境（如飞行自组织网络 (FANETs)）时，它们通常会面临局限性。本文探讨利用数据驱动的 Koopman 方法来应对这些挑战。具体来说，我们研究了这些方法如何在 FANETs 中对无人机轨迹动力学进行建模，从而实现更精确的预测并提高网络性能。通过利用 Koopman 算子理论，我们提出了两种可能的方法——集中式和分布式——以有效应对 FANETs 不断变化的拓扑结构带来的挑战。为了证明这一点，我们考虑一个 FANET，它执行对无人机进行监控的任务，无人机遵循预定的轨迹，并预测信干噪比 (SINR)，以确保无人机之间的可靠通信。我们的结果表明，这些方法可以准确预测导致建模通信中断的连接和隔离事件。这种能力可以帮助无人机根据这些预测安排它们的传输。
tldr: This paper uses Koopman operator theory to predict connectivity in flying ad hoc networks (FANETs), particularly focusing on UAV communication reliability in dynamic environments.
tldr_zh: 本文利用 Koopman 算子理论预测飞行自组织网络 (FANET) 中的连接性，特别关注动态环境中无人机通信的可靠性。

title: Student Engagement in AI Assisted Complex Problem Solving: A Pilot Study of Human AI Rubik's Cube Collaboration
summary: Games and puzzles play important pedagogical roles in STEM learning. New AI algorithms that can solve complex problems offer opportunities for scaffolded instruction in puzzle solving. This paper presents the ALLURE system, which uses an AI algorithm (DeepCubeA) to guide students in solving a common first step of the Rubik's Cube (i.e., the white cross). Using data from a pilot study we present preliminary findings about students' behaviors in the system, how these behaviors are associated with STEM skills - including spatial reasoning, critical thinking and algorithmic thinking. We discuss how data from ALLURE can be used in future educational data mining to understand how students benefit from AI assistance and collaboration when solving complex problems.
summary_zh: 游戏和谜题在 STEM 学习中扮演着重要的教学角色。能够解决复杂问题的新型人工智能算法为谜题解决中的支架式教学提供了机会。本文介绍了 ALLURE 系统，该系统使用人工智能算法（DeepCubeA）来指导学生解决魔方的一个常见起始步骤（即白色十字）。利用来自一项初步研究的数据，我们展示了关于学生在系统中的行为的初步发现，以及这些行为如何与 STEM 技能相关联，包括空间推理、批判性思维和算法思维。我们讨论了 ALLURE 中的数据如何在未来的教育数据挖掘中被用来理解学生如何在解决复杂问题时从人工智能辅助和协作中获益。
tldr: This paper introduces ALLURE, an AI-assisted Rubik's Cube solving system, and presents preliminary findings from a pilot study on student engagement and its connection to STEM skills.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个名为ALLURE的AI辅助魔方解算系统，并展示了一个关于学生参与度及其与STEM技能之间联系的初步研究结果。

title: XR-1: Towards Versatile Vision-Language-Action Models via Learning Unified Vision-Motion Representations
summary: Recent progress in large-scale robotic datasets and vision-language models (VLMs) has advanced research on vision-language-action (VLA) models. However, existing VLA models still face two fundamental challenges: (i) producing precise low-level actions from high-dimensional observations, (ii) bridging domain gaps across heterogeneous data sources, including diverse robot embodiments and human demonstrations. Existing methods often encode latent variables from either visual dynamics or robotic actions to guide policy learning, but they fail to fully exploit the complementary multi-modal knowledge present in large-scale, heterogeneous datasets. In this work, we present X Robotic Model 1 (XR-1), a novel framework for versatile and scalable VLA learning across diverse robots, tasks, and environments. XR-1 introduces the \emph{Unified Vision-Motion Codes (UVMC)}, a discrete latent representation learned via a dual-branch VQ-VAE that jointly encodes visual dynamics and robotic motion. UVMC addresses these challenges by (i) serving as an intermediate representation between the observations and actions, and (ii) aligning multimodal dynamic information from heterogeneous data sources to capture complementary knowledge. To effectively exploit UVMC, we propose a three-stage training paradigm: (i) self-supervised UVMC learning, (ii) UVMC-guided pretraining on large-scale cross-embodiment robotic datasets, and (iii) task-specific post-training. We validate XR-1 through extensive real-world experiments with more than 14,000 rollouts on six different robot embodiments, spanning over 120 diverse manipulation tasks. XR-1 consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines such as $π_{0.5}$, $π_0$, RDT, UniVLA, and GR00T-N1.5 while demonstrating strong generalization to novel objects, background variations, distractors, and illumination changes. Our project is at https://xr-1-vla.github.io/.
summary_zh: 大型机器人数据集和视觉语言模型（VLM）的最新进展推动了视觉语言动作（VLA）模型的研究。然而，现有的VLA模型仍然面临两个根本性的挑战：（i）从高维观测中生成精确的底层动作；（ii）弥合跨异构数据源的领域差距，包括不同的机器人形态和人类演示。现有方法通常编码来自视觉动态或机器人动作的潜在变量来指导策略学习，但它们未能充分利用大规模异构数据集中存在的互补性多模态知识。在这项工作中，我们提出了X Robotic Model 1 (XR-1)，这是一个用于跨不同机器人、任务和环境进行通用且可扩展VLA学习的新颖框架。XR-1引入了\emph{统一视觉-运动码（UVMC）}，这是一种通过双分支VQ-VAE学习的离散潜在表示，它联合编码视觉动态和机器人运动。UVMC通过以下方式应对这些挑战：（i）作为观测和动作之间的中间表示；（ii）对齐来自异构数据源的多模态动态信息以捕获互补知识。为了有效利用UVMC，我们提出了一种三阶段训练范式：（i）自监督UVMC学习；（ii）基于大规模跨形态机器人数据集的UVMC引导预训练；（iii）任务特定的后训练。我们通过超过14,000次真实世界实验验证了XR-1，这些实验在六种不同的机器人形态上进行，跨越120多个不同的操作任务。XR-1始终优于最先进的基线方法，例如$π_{0.5}$、$π_0$、RDT、UniVLA和GR00T-N1.5，同时展示出对新颖物体、背景变化、干扰物和光照变化的强大泛化能力。我们的项目位于https://xr-1-vla.github.io/。
tldr: The paper introduces XR-1, a Vision-Language-Action model that utilizes Unified Vision-Motion Codes (UVMC) learned via a dual-branch VQ-VAE to address challenges in robotic control across diverse embodiments and tasks. XR-1 demonstrates strong performance and generalization in real-world robotic manipulation experiments.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了 XR-1，一个视觉-语言-动作模型，它利用通过双分支 VQ-VAE 学习的统一视觉-运动代码 (UVMC) 来解决不同机器人和任务中的控制挑战。XR-1 在真实机器人操作实验中表现出强大的性能和泛化能力。

title: From the Laboratory to Real-World Application: Evaluating Zero-Shot Scene Interpretation on Edge Devices for Mobile Robotics
summary: Video Understanding, Scene Interpretation and Commonsense Reasoning are highly challenging tasks enabling the interpretation of visual information, allowing agents to perceive, interact with and make rational decisions in its environment. Large Language Models (LLMs) and Visual Language Models (VLMs) have shown remarkable advancements in these areas in recent years, enabling domain-specific applications as well as zero-shot open vocabulary tasks, combining multiple domains. However, the required computational complexity poses challenges for their application on edge devices and in the context of Mobile Robotics, especially considering the trade-off between accuracy and inference time. In this paper, we investigate the capabilities of state-of-the-art VLMs for the task of Scene Interpretation and Action Recognition, with special regard to small VLMs capable of being deployed to edge devices in the context of Mobile Robotics. The proposed pipeline is evaluated on a diverse dataset consisting of various real-world cityscape, on-campus and indoor scenarios. The experimental evaluation discusses the potential of these small models on edge devices, with particular emphasis on challenges, weaknesses, inherent model biases and the application of the gained information. Supplementary material is provided via the following repository: https://datahub.rz.rptu.de/hstr-csrl-public/publications/scene-interpretation-on-edge-devices/
summary_zh: 视频理解、场景解释和常识推理是极具挑战性的任务，它们能够解释视觉信息，使智能体能够感知环境、与之交互并在其中做出理性的决策。近年来，大型语言模型（LLMs）和视觉语言模型（VLMs）在这些领域取得了显著进展，从而能够实现领域特定的应用以及零样本开放词汇任务，并结合多个领域。然而，所需的计算复杂度对它们在边缘设备上以及在移动机器人环境中的应用提出了挑战，尤其是在考虑准确性和推理时间之间的权衡时。在本文中，我们研究了最先进的VLMs在场景解释和动作识别任务上的能力，特别是考虑了能够在移动机器人环境中部署到边缘设备的小型VLMs。所提出的流程在一个由各种真实世界的城市景观、校园和室内场景组成的多样化数据集上进行了评估。实验评估探讨了这些小型模型在边缘设备上的潜力，特别强调了挑战、弱点、固有的模型偏差以及所获得信息的应用。补充材料通过以下存储库提供：https://datahub.rz.rptu.de/hstr-csrl-public/publications/scene-interpretation-on-edge-devices/
tldr: This paper evaluates the performance of small Vision-Language Models on edge devices for scene interpretation and action recognition in mobile robotics, highlighting challenges and potential biases in real-world settings.
tldr_zh: 本文评估了小型视觉语言模型在边缘设备上进行场景解读和动作识别的性能，适用于移动机器人，并强调了真实世界场景中的挑战和潜在偏差。

title: LACY: A Vision-Language Model-based Language-Action Cycle for Self-Improving Robotic Manipulation
summary: Learning generalizable policies for robotic manipulation increasingly relies on large-scale models that map language instructions to actions (L2A). However, this one-way paradigm often produces policies that execute tasks without deeper contextual understanding, limiting their ability to generalize or explain their behavior. We argue that the complementary skill of mapping actions back to language (A2L) is essential for developing more holistic grounding. An agent capable of both acting and explaining its actions can form richer internal representations and unlock new paradigms for self-supervised learning. We introduce LACY (Language-Action Cycle), a unified framework that learns such bidirectional mappings within a single vision-language model. LACY is jointly trained on three synergistic tasks: generating parameterized actions from language (L2A), explaining observed actions in language (A2L), and verifying semantic consistency between two language descriptions (L2C). This enables a self-improving cycle that autonomously generates and filters new training data through an active augmentation strategy targeting low-confidence cases, thereby improving the model without additional human labels. Experiments on pick-and-place tasks in both simulation and the real world show that LACY improves task success rates by 56.46% on average and yields more robust language-action grounding for robotic manipulation. Project page: https://vla2026.github.io/LACY/
summary_zh: 用于机器人操作的通用策略学习越来越依赖于将语言指令映射到动作（L2A）的大规模模型。然而，这种单向范式常常产生在缺乏更深层次的上下文理解情况下执行任务的策略，限制了它们泛化或解释其行为的能力。我们认为，将动作映射回语言（A2L）的互补技能对于开发更全面的语义基础至关重要。如果一个智能体能够执行动作并解释其动作，它就可以形成更丰富的内部表征，并为自监督学习解锁新的范式。我们提出了LACY（语言-动作循环），这是一个统一的框架，可以在单个视觉-语言模型中学习这种双向映射。 LACY 在三个协同任务上联合训练：从语言生成参数化动作（L2A）、用语言解释观察到的动作（A2L）以及验证两个语言描述之间的语义一致性（L2C）。这使得一个自我改进的循环能够通过一种针对低置信度案例的主动增强策略自主生成和过滤新的训练数据，从而在无需额外人工标注的情况下改进模型。在模拟和真实世界中抓取放置任务的实验表明，LACY 使任务成功率平均提高了 56.46%，并为机器人操作产生了更鲁棒的语言-动作语义基础。项目主页：https://vla2026.github.io/LACY/
tldr: The paper introduces LACY, a vision-language model-based framework for robotic manipulation that learns bidirectional language-action mappings (L2A and A2L) and semantic consistency to achieve self-improvement through active data augmentation, demonstrating improved task success in pick-and-place tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了LACY，一个基于视觉-语言模型的机器人操作框架，它学习双向语言-动作映射（L2A和A2L）和语义一致性，通过主动数据增强实现自我改进，并在抓取放置任务中展示了更高的任务成功率。

title: Text to Robotic Assembly of Multi Component Objects using 3D Generative AI and Vision Language Models
summary: Advances in 3D generative AI have enabled the creation of physical objects from text prompts, but challenges remain in creating objects involving multiple component types. We present a pipeline that integrates 3D generative AI with vision-language models (VLMs) to enable the robotic assembly of multi-component objects from natural language. Our method leverages VLMs for zero-shot, multi-modal reasoning about geometry and functionality to decompose AI-generated meshes into multi-component 3D models using predefined structural and panel components. We demonstrate that a VLM is capable of determining which mesh regions need panel components in addition to structural components, based on the object's geometry and functionality. Evaluation across test objects shows that users preferred the VLM-generated assignments 90.6% of the time, compared to 59.4% for rule-based and 2.5% for random assignment. Lastly, the system allows users to refine component assignments through conversational feedback, enabling greater human control and agency in making physical objects with generative AI and robotics.
summary_zh: 3D生成式人工智能的进步使得通过文本提示创建物理对象成为可能，但涉及多种组件类型的对象创建仍然面临挑战。我们提出了一种管道，将3D生成式人工智能与视觉-语言模型(VLMs)集成，以实现从自然语言进行多组件对象的机器人组装。我们的方法利用VLMs对几何形状和功能进行零样本、多模态推理，从而使用预定义的结构和面板组件将人工智能生成的网格分解为多组件3D模型。我们证明了VLM能够根据对象的几何形状和功能，确定哪些网格区域除了结构组件之外还需要面板组件。对测试对象的评估表明，用户对VLM生成的分配方案的偏好度为90.6%，而基于规则和随机分配的偏好度分别为59.4%和2.5%。最后，该系统允许用户通过对话反馈来优化组件分配，从而在使用生成式人工智能和机器人技术制造物理对象时，实现更大程度的人工控制和自主性。
tldr: This paper presents a pipeline using 3D generative AI and vision-language models (VLMs) for robotic assembly of multi-component objects from text, demonstrating VLMs' superior performance in component assignment compared to rule-based and random methods and allowing conversational refinement.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种使用3D生成式AI和视觉-语言模型(VLMs)的管道，用于从文本进行多组件物体的机器人组装，展示了VLM在组件分配方面优于基于规则和随机方法的效果，并允许通过对话进行细化。

title: TRACE: Textual Reasoning for Affordance Coordinate Extraction
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) struggle to translate high-level instructions into the precise spatial affordances required for robotic manipulation. While visual Chain-of-Thought (CoT) methods exist, they are often computationally intensive. In this work, we introduce TRACE (Textual Reasoning for Affordance Coordinate Extraction), a novel methodology that integrates a textual Chain of Reasoning (CoR) into the affordance prediction process. We use this methodology to create the TRACE dataset, a large-scale collection created via an autonomous pipeline that pairs instructions with explicit textual rationales. By fine-tuning a VLM on this data, our model learns to externalize its spatial reasoning before acting. Our experiments show that our TRACE-tuned model achieves state-of-the-art performance, reaching 48.1% accuracy on the primary Where2Place (W2P) benchmark (a 9.6% relative improvement) and 55.0% on the more challenging W2P(h) subset. Crucially, an ablation study demonstrates that performance scales directly with the amount of reasoning data used, confirming the CoR's effectiveness. Furthermore, analysis of the model's attention maps reveals an interpretable reasoning process where focus shifts dynamically across reasoning steps. This work shows that training VLMs to generate a textual CoR is an effective and robust strategy for enhancing the precision, reliability, and interpretability of VLM-based robot control. Our dataset and code are available at https://github.com/jink-ucla/TRACE
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型 (VLMs) 难以将高层指令转化为机器人操作所需的精确空间可供性。虽然已存在视觉思维链 (CoT) 方法，但它们通常计算密集。在这项工作中，我们介绍 TRACE (可供性坐标提取的文本推理)，一种将文本推理链 (CoR) 集成到可供性预测过程中的新颖方法。我们使用该方法创建了 TRACE 数据集，这是一个通过自主管道生成的大规模数据集，将指令与显式的文本理由配对。通过在此数据上微调 VLM，我们的模型学习在行动前将空间推理外化。我们的实验表明，经过 TRACE 调优的模型实现了最先进的性能，在主要的 Where2Place (W2P) 基准测试中达到 48.1% 的准确率（相对提升 9.6%），在更具挑战性的 W2P(h) 子集中达到 55.0%。至关重要的是，一项消融研究表明，性能与使用的推理数据量直接相关，证实了 CoR 的有效性。此外，对模型注意力图的分析揭示了一个可解释的推理过程，其中焦点在推理步骤中动态转移。这项工作表明，训练 VLM 生成文本 CoR 是增强基于 VLM 的机器人控制的精度、可靠性和可解释性的有效且稳健的策略。 我们的数据集和代码可在 https://github.com/jink-ucla/TRACE 上获得。
tldr: The paper introduces TRACE, a novel method that incorporates textual Chain-of-Reasoning (CoR) to improve the affordance prediction of vision-language models (VLMs) for robot manipulation, and presents a dataset created using this method, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance on Where2Place benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了TRACE，一种新颖的方法，通过结合文本推理链（CoR）来提高视觉语言模型（VLMs）在机器人操作中的可供性预测，并提出了使用该方法创建的数据集，在Where2Place基准测试中表现出最先进的性能。

title: The Collaboration Gap
summary: The trajectory of AI development suggests that we will increasingly rely on agent-based systems composed of independently developed agents with different information, privileges, and tools. The success of these systems will critically depend on effective collaboration among these heterogeneous agents, even under partial observability. Despite intense interest, few empirical studies have evaluated such agent-agent collaboration at scale. We propose a collaborative maze-solving benchmark that (i) isolates collaborative capabilities, (ii) modulates problem complexity, (iii) enables scalable automated grading, and (iv) imposes no output-format constraints, preserving ecological plausibility. Using this framework, we evaluate 32 leading open- and closed-source models in solo, homogeneous, and heterogeneous pairings. Our results reveal a "collaboration gap": models that perform well solo often degrade substantially when required to collaborate. Collaboration can break down dramatically; for instance, small distilled models that solve mazes well alone may fail almost completely in certain pairings. We find that starting with the stronger agent often improves outcomes, motivating a "relay inference" approach where the stronger agent leads before handing off to the weaker one, closing much of the gap. Our findings argue for (1) collaboration-aware evaluation, (2) training strategies developed to enhance collaborative capabilities, and (3) interaction design that reliably elicits agents' latent skills, guidance that applies to AI-AI and human-AI collaboration.
summary_zh: 人工智能发展趋势表明，我们将越来越依赖于基于智能体的系统，这些系统由独立开发的、拥有不同信息、权限和工具的智能体组成。这些系统的成功将关键取决于这些异构智能体之间有效的协作，即使在部分可观测性下也是如此。尽管人们对此兴趣浓厚，但很少有实证研究大规模地评估这种智能体-智能体之间的协作。我们提出了一个协作迷宫求解基准，它（i）隔离了协作能力，（ii）调节了问题复杂度，（iii）实现了可扩展的自动评分，以及（iv）没有施加输出格式的约束，从而保留了生态合理性。利用这个框架，我们评估了32个领先的开源和闭源模型在单人、同构和异构配对中的表现。我们的结果揭示了一个“协作差距”：单独表现良好的模型在需要协作时通常会显著下降。协作可能会急剧崩溃；例如，单独求解迷宫效果良好的小型蒸馏模型在某些配对中可能几乎完全失败。我们发现从更强大的智能体开始通常可以改善结果，这激发了一种“接力推理”方法，即更强大的智能体先主导，然后再交给较弱的智能体，从而缩小大部分差距。我们的研究结果论证了(1)协作感知评估，(2)为增强协作能力而开发的训练策略，以及(3)可靠地激发智能体的潜在技能的交互设计，这些指导适用于AI-AI和人-AI协作。
tldr: This paper introduces a collaborative maze-solving benchmark to evaluate agent-agent collaboration at scale, revealing a "collaboration gap" where individual agent performance degrades in collaborative settings, and proposes a relay inference approach to mitigate this gap.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个协作迷宫求解基准，用于大规模评估agent间的协作，揭示了“协作差距”，即个体agent的性能在协作环境中会下降，并提出了一种中继推理方法来弥合这一差距。

title: Adaptive Neighborhood-Constrained Q Learning for Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) suffers from extrapolation errors induced by out-of-distribution (OOD) actions. To address this, offline RL algorithms typically impose constraints on action selection, which can be systematically categorized into density, support, and sample constraints. However, we show that each category has inherent limitations: density and sample constraints tend to be overly conservative in many scenarios, while the support constraint, though least restrictive, faces challenges in accurately modeling the behavior policy. To overcome these limitations, we propose a new neighborhood constraint that restricts action selection in the Bellman target to the union of neighborhoods of dataset actions. Theoretically, the constraint not only bounds extrapolation errors and distribution shift under certain conditions, but also approximates the support constraint without requiring behavior policy modeling. Moreover, it retains substantial flexibility and enables pointwise conservatism by adapting the neighborhood radius for each data point. In practice, we employ data quality as the adaptation criterion and design an adaptive neighborhood constraint. Building on an efficient bilevel optimization framework, we develop a simple yet effective algorithm, Adaptive Neighborhood-constrained Q learning (ANQ), to perform Q learning with target actions satisfying this constraint. Empirically, ANQ achieves state-of-the-art performance on standard offline RL benchmarks and exhibits strong robustness in scenarios with noisy or limited data.
summary_zh: 离线强化学习(RL)受到分布外(OOD)动作引起的推断错误的影响。为了解决这个问题，离线RL算法通常对动作选择施加约束，这些约束可以系统地分为密度、支持和样本约束。然而，我们表明每个类别都有其固有的局限性：密度和样本约束在许多场景中往往过于保守，而支持约束虽然限制最少，但在准确建模行为策略方面面临挑战。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了一种新的邻域约束，该约束将贝尔曼目标中的动作选择限制在数据集动作的邻域的并集内。从理论上讲，该约束不仅在特定条件下限制了推断误差和分布偏移，而且无需行为策略建模即可逼近支持约束。此外，它保留了很大的灵活性，并通过调整每个数据点的邻域半径来实现逐点的保守性。在实践中，我们采用数据质量作为自适应标准，并设计了一种自适应邻域约束。基于一个高效的双层优化框架，我们开发了一种简单而有效的算法，自适应邻域约束Q学习（ANQ），以执行满足此约束的目标动作的Q学习。在经验上，ANQ在标准的离线RL基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，并在存在噪声或有限数据的场景中表现出强大的鲁棒性。
tldr: This paper introduces Adaptive Neighborhood-constrained Q learning (ANQ) for offline reinforcement learning, which overcomes limitations of existing constraint-based methods by adapting the neighborhood radius for each data point based on data quality, achieving state-of-the-art performance and robustness.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了用于离线强化学习的自适应邻域约束Q学习（ANQ）算法，通过根据数据质量自适应地调整每个数据点的邻域半径，克服了现有基于约束方法局限性，实现了最先进的性能和稳健性。

title: Extending RLVR to Open-Ended Tasks via Verifiable Multiple-Choice Reformulation
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards(RLVR) has demonstrated great potential in enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, its success has thus far been largely confined to the mathematical and programming domains with clear and automatically checkable outcomes. Reinforcement learning on open-ended tasks (e.g., creative writing and subjective Q&A) continues to rely on reward models due to the absence of verifiable solutions. This raises a key question: how can we extend RLVR to strengthen reasoning in open-ended tasks regardless of the absence of the unambiguous ground truth? To overcome this challenge, we introduce Verifiable Multiple-Choice Reformulation for Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (VMR-RLVR), a novel training strategy that restructures open-ended data into verifiable multiple-choice formats, enabling effective training even in the absence of explicit ground truth. Experimental results on multiple benchmarks validate the effectiveness of our method in improving LLM performance on open-ended tasks. Notably, across seven open-ended benchmarks, our VMR-RLVR training delivers an average gain of 3.29 points over the RL with reward model.
summary_zh: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习(RLVR)在增强大型语言模型(LLM)的推理能力方面展现出巨大潜力。然而，其成功至今主要局限于数学和编程领域，这些领域具有明确且可自动检查的结果。由于缺乏可验证的解决方案，开放式任务（例如，创意写作和主观问答）上的强化学习仍然依赖于奖励模型。这就引出了一个关键问题：我们如何在缺乏明确真值的情况下，将RLVR扩展到增强开放式任务中的推理能力？为了克服这一挑战，我们引入了可验证多项选择重构用于基于可验证奖励的强化学习(VMR-RLVR)，这是一种新颖的训练策略，该策略将开放式数据重构为可验证的多项选择形式，从而即使在缺乏显式真值的情况下也能进行有效训练。在多个基准测试上的实验结果验证了我们的方法在提高LLM在开放式任务上的性能方面的有效性。值得注意的是，在七个开放式基准测试中，我们的VMR-RLVR训练比使用奖励模型的强化学习平均提升了3.29个百分点。
tldr: The paper introduces VMR-RLVR, a method to extend Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) to open-ended tasks by reformulating data into a verifiable multiple-choice format, achieving performance gains over reward model based RL on multiple benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了VMR-RLVR，一种通过将数据重构为可验证的多项选择形式，将具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）扩展到开放式任务的方法。相较于基于奖励模型的强化学习，该方法在多个基准测试中均取得了性能提升。

title: ReAcTree: Hierarchical LLM Agent Trees with Control Flow for Long-Horizon Task Planning
summary: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have enabled significant progress in decision-making and task planning for embodied autonomous agents. However, most existing methods struggle with complex, long-horizon tasks because they rely on a monolithic trajectory that entangles all past decisions and observations to solve the entire task in a single unified process. To address this limitation, we propose ReAcTree, a hierarchical task-planning method that decomposes a complex goal into manageable subgoals within a dynamically constructed agent tree. Each subgoal is handled by an LLM agent node capable of reasoning, acting, and further expanding the tree, while control flow nodes coordinate the execution strategies of agent nodes. In addition, we integrate two complementary memory systems: each agent node retrieves goal-specific, subgoal-level examples from episodic memory and shares environment-specific observations through working memory. Experiments on the WAH-NL and ALFRED show ReAcTree consistently outperforms strong task-planning baselines such as ReAct across diverse LLMs. Notably, on WAH-NL, ReAcTree achieves a 61% goal success rate with Qwen 2.5 72B, nearly doubling ReAct's 31%. The code is available at https://github.com/Choi-JaeWoo/ReAcTree.git.
summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 的最新进展显著推动了具身自主智能体在决策和任务规划方面的进步。然而，现有的大多数方法难以应对复杂、长时程的任务，因为它们依赖于单一的轨迹，将所有过去的决策和观察纠缠在一起，从而在一个统一的过程中解决整个任务。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了 ReAcTree，一种分层任务规划方法，它将复杂的目标分解为动态构建的智能体树内的可管理子目标。每个子目标由一个 LLM 智能体节点处理，该节点能够进行推理、行动并进一步扩展树，而控制流节点协调智能体节点的执行策略。此外，我们集成了两个互补的记忆系统：每个智能体节点从情景记忆中检索特定于目标的子目标级别示例，并通过工作记忆共享特定于环境的观察。在 WAH-NL 和 ALFRED 上的实验表明，ReAcTree 在各种 LLM 上始终优于强大的任务规划基线，例如 ReAct。值得注意的是，在 WAH-NL 上，ReAcTree 使用 Qwen 2.5 72B 实现了 61% 的目标成功率，几乎是 ReAct 的 31% 的两倍。代码可在 https://github.com/Choi-JaeWoo/ReAcTree.git 获取。
tldr: ReAcTree introduces a hierarchical LLM agent tree structure for long-horizon task planning, achieving significant improvements over existing methods like ReAct in complex environments such as WAH-NL and ALFRED.
tldr_zh: ReAcTree 引入了一种用于长周期任务规划的分层 LLM 代理树结构，在 WAH-NL 和 ALFRED 等复杂环境中，相比 ReAct 等现有方法取得了显著改进。

title: V-Agent: An Interactive Video Search System Using Vision-Language Models
summary: We introduce V-Agent, a novel multi-agent platform designed for advanced video search and interactive user-system conversations. By fine-tuning a vision-language model (VLM) with a small video preference dataset and enhancing it with a retrieval vector from an image-text retrieval model, we overcome the limitations of traditional text-based retrieval systems in multimodal scenarios. The VLM-based retrieval model independently embeds video frames and audio transcriptions from an automatic speech recognition (ASR) module into a shared multimodal representation space, enabling V-Agent to interpret both visual and spoken content for context-aware video search. This system consists of three agents-a routing agent, a search agent, and a chat agent-that work collaboratively to address user intents by refining search outputs and communicating with users. The search agent utilizes the VLM-based retrieval model together with an additional re-ranking module to further enhance video retrieval quality. Our proposed framework demonstrates state-of-the-art zero-shot performance on the MultiVENT 2.0 benchmark, highlighting its potential for both academic research and real-world applications. The retrieval model and demo videos are available at https://huggingface.co/NCSOFT/multimodal-embedding.
summary_zh: 我们介绍了V-Agent，一种用于高级视频搜索和交互式用户-系统对话的新型多智能体平台。通过使用小型视频偏好数据集微调视觉-语言模型（VLM），并利用图像-文本检索模型的检索向量增强它，我们克服了传统基于文本的检索系统在多模态场景中的局限性。基于VLM的检索模型独立地将视频帧和来自自动语音识别（ASR）模块的音频转录本嵌入到一个共享的多模态表示空间中，从而使V-Agent能够解释视觉和口语内容，以进行上下文感知的视频搜索。该系统由三个智能体——路由智能体、搜索智能体和聊天智能体——组成，它们协同工作，通过优化搜索结果并与用户沟通来解决用户意图。搜索智能体利用基于VLM的检索模型以及一个额外的重排序模块来进一步提高视频检索质量。我们提出的框架在MultiVENT 2.0基准测试中展示了最先进的零样本性能，突出了其在学术研究和实际应用中的潜力。检索模型和演示视频可在https://huggingface.co/NCSOFT/multimodal-embedding获取。
tldr: V-Agent is a multi-agent video search system that leverages a fine-tuned vision-language model for context-aware video retrieval, achieving state-of-the-art zero-shot performance on the MultiVENT 2.0 benchmark and is available for academic research.
tldr_zh: V-Agent 是一个多代理视频搜索系统，利用微调的视觉-语言模型进行上下文感知的视频检索，在 MultiVENT 2.0 基准测试中实现了最先进的零样本性能，并可用于学术研究。

title: Training Proactive and Personalized LLM Agents
summary: While existing work focuses primarily on task success, we argue that effective real-world agents require optimizing three dimensions: productivity (task completion), proactivity (asking essential questions), and personalization (adapting to diverse user preferences). We introduce UserVille, an interactive environment with LLM-based user simulators enabling diverse, configurable user preferences. Leveraging UserVille, we introduce PPP, a multi-objective reinforcement learning approach that jointly optimizes all three dimensions: Productivity, Proactivity, and Personalization. Experiments on software engineering and deep research tasks show that agents trained with PPP achieve substantial improvements over strong baselines such as GPT-5 (+21.6 on average), demonstrating the ability to ask strategic clarifying questions, adapt to unseen user preferences, and improve task success through better interaction. This work demonstrates that explicitly optimizing for user-centered interaction is critical for building practical and effective AI agents.
summary_zh: 现有研究主要关注任务成功率，但我们认为，有效的现实世界智能体需要优化以下三个维度：生产力（任务完成）、主动性（提出关键问题）和个性化（适应不同的用户偏好）。我们引入了UserVille，这是一个交互式环境，包含基于大语言模型的用户模拟器，能够模拟多样化、可配置的用户偏好。基于UserVille，我们提出了PPP，一种多目标强化学习方法，它联合优化所有三个维度：生产力、主动性和个性化。在软件工程和深度研究任务上的实验表明，用PPP训练的智能体比强大的基线模型（如GPT-5，平均提高21.6）取得了显著的改进，展现了提出战略性澄清性问题、适应未见用户偏好以及通过更好的交互提升任务成功率的能力。这项工作证明了显式地优化以用户为中心的交互对于构建实用且有效的AI智能体至关重要。
tldr: The paper introduces a novel reinforcement learning approach, PPP, trained in a simulated environment (UserVille) to optimize productivity, proactivity, and personalization in LLM agents, demonstrating significant improvements over baselines like GPT-5.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了一种新的强化学习方法 PPP，它在模拟环境 (UserVille) 中进行训练，以优化 LLM 代理的生产力、主动性和个性化，并展示了相对于 GPT-5 等基线的显着改进。

title: Optimal-Agent-Selection: State-Aware Routing Framework for Efficient Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: The emergence of multi-agent systems powered by large language models (LLMs) has unlocked new frontiers in complex task-solving, enabling diverse agents to integrate unique expertise, collaborate flexibly, and address challenges unattainable for individual models. However, the full potential of such systems is hindered by rigid agent scheduling and inefficient coordination strategies that fail to adapt to evolving task requirements. In this paper, we propose STRMAC, a state-aware routing framework designed for efficient collaboration in multi-agent systems. Our method separately encodes interaction history and agent knowledge to power the router, which adaptively selects the most suitable single agent at each step for efficient and effective collaboration. Furthermore, we introduce a self-evolving data generation approach that accelerates the collection of high-quality execution paths for efficient system training. Experiments on challenging collaborative reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, achieving up to 23.8% improvement over baselines and reducing data collection overhead by up to 90.1% compared to exhaustive search.
summary_zh: 由大型语言模型（LLMs）驱动的多智能体系统的出现，为解决复杂任务开辟了新的前沿，使不同的智能体能够整合独特的专业知识、灵活协作，并应对单个模型无法完成的挑战。然而，这种系统的全部潜力受到僵化的智能体调度和低效的协调策略的阻碍，这些策略无法适应不断演变的任务需求。在本文中，我们提出了STRMAC，一个为多智能体系统中的高效协作而设计的状态感知路由框架。我们的方法分别编码交互历史和智能体知识来驱动路由器，该路由器自适应地选择每一步最合适的单个智能体，以实现高效和有效的协作。此外，我们引入了一种自演化的数据生成方法，能够加速高质量执行路径的收集，以实现高效的系统训练。在具有挑战性的协作推理基准上的实验表明，我们的方法实现了最先进的性能，与基线相比实现了高达23.8%的改进，并且与穷举搜索相比，数据收集开销降低了高达90.1%。
tldr: This paper introduces STRMAC, a state-aware routing framework for multi-agent systems using LLMs, which adaptively selects the optimal agent at each step based on interaction history and agent knowledge, achieving state-of-the-art performance and reduced data collection overhead.
tldr_zh: 该论文介绍了STRMAC，一个基于LLM的多智能体系统中使用的状态感知路由框架。该框架基于交互历史和智能体知识自适应地选择每一步的最佳智能体，实现了最先进的性能并减少了数据收集开销。

title: Automated Reward Design for Gran Turismo
summary: When designing reinforcement learning (RL) agents, a designer communicates the desired agent behavior through the definition of reward functions - numerical feedback given to the agent as reward or punishment for its actions. However, mapping desired behaviors to reward functions can be a difficult process, especially in complex environments such as autonomous racing. In this paper, we demonstrate how current foundation models can effectively search over a space of reward functions to produce desirable RL agents for the Gran Turismo 7 racing game, given only text-based instructions. Through a combination of LLM-based reward generation, VLM preference-based evaluation, and human feedback we demonstrate how our system can be used to produce racing agents competitive with GT Sophy, a champion-level RL racing agent, as well as generate novel behaviors, paving the way for practical automated reward design in real world applications.
summary_zh: 在设计强化学习（RL）智能体时，设计者通过奖励函数的定义来传达期望的智能体行为 - 给智能体针对其行为的数值反馈，作为奖励或惩罚。然而，将期望的行为映射到奖励函数可能是一个困难的过程，尤其是在像自动驾驶赛车这样复杂的环境中。在本文中，我们展示了当前的基础模型如何在奖励函数空间中进行有效搜索，仅给定基于文本的指令，即可为《Gran Turismo 7》赛车游戏生成理想的强化学习智能体。通过结合基于大型语言模型（LLM）的奖励生成、基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的偏好评估和人工反馈，我们证明了我们的系统可以被用来生成能够与GT Sophy（冠军级强化学习赛车智能体）竞争的赛车智能体，并生成新颖的行为，从而为现实世界应用中实用的自动化奖励设计铺平道路。
tldr: This paper presents a system leveraging Large Language Models and Vision-Language Models for automated reward design in Gran Turismo 7, creating racing agents competitive with champion-level agents and generating novel behaviors.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种利用大型语言模型和视觉语言模型在Gran Turismo 7中自动设计奖励的系统，该系统可以生成与冠军级智能体竞争的赛车智能体，并产生新颖的行为。

title: Natural Building Blocks for Structured World Models: Theory, Evidence, and Scaling
summary: The field of world modeling is fragmented, with researchers developing bespoke architectures that rarely build upon each other. We propose a framework that specifies the natural building blocks for structured world models based on the fundamental stochastic processes that any world model must capture: discrete processes (logic, symbols) and continuous processes (physics, dynamics); the world model is then defined by the hierarchical composition of these building blocks. We examine Hidden Markov Models (HMMs) and switching linear dynamical systems (sLDS) as natural building blocks for discrete and continuous modeling--which become partially-observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs) and controlled sLDS when augmented with actions. This modular approach supports both passive modeling (generation, forecasting) and active control (planning, decision-making) within the same architecture. We avoid the combinatorial explosion of traditional structure learning by largely fixing the causal architecture and searching over only four depth parameters. We review practical expressiveness through multimodal generative modeling (passive) and planning from pixels (active), with performance competitive to neural approaches while maintaining interpretability. The core outstanding challenge is scalable joint structure-parameter learning; current methods finesse this by cleverly growing structure and parameters incrementally, but are limited in their scalability. If solved, these natural building blocks could provide foundational infrastructure for world modeling, analogous to how standardized layers enabled progress in deep learning.
summary_zh: 世界建模领域目前较为零散，研究人员开发的定制架构很少相互借鉴。我们提出一个框架，该框架基于任何世界模型都必须捕捉的基本随机过程，指定了结构化世界模型的自然构建块：离散过程（逻辑、符号）和连续过程（物理、动力学）；然后，世界模型由这些构建块的层级组合来定义。我们研究了隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）和切换线性动态系统（sLDS）作为离散和连续建模的自然构建块——当增加动作控制时，它们分别变为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）和受控sLDS。这种模块化方法支持同一架构内的被动建模（生成、预测）和主动控制（规划、决策）。我们通过大致固定因果架构并仅搜索四个深度参数，避免了传统结构学习的组合爆炸。我们通过多模态生成建模（被动）和从像素进行规划（主动）来评估实际的表达能力，其性能与神经方法相比具有竞争力，同时保持了可解释性。目前核心的突出挑战是可扩展的联合结构-参数学习；目前的方法巧妙地通过增量增长结构和参数来解决这个问题，但其可扩展性有限。如果这个问题得到解决，这些自然构建块可以为世界建模提供基础架构，类似于标准化层如何促进深度学习的进步。
tldr: This paper proposes a modular framework for structured world models using discrete and continuous stochastic processes as building blocks, aiming for scalable joint structure-parameter learning and interpretability, analogous to standardized layers in deep learning.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个用于构建结构化世界模型的模块化框架，使用离散和连续随机过程作为构建模块，旨在实现可扩展的联合结构-参数学习和可解释性，类似于深度学习中的标准化层。

title: Human-AI Co-Embodied Intelligence for Scientific Experimentation and Manufacturing
summary: Scientific experimentation and manufacturing rely on prolonged protocol development and complex, multi-step implementation, which require continuous human expertise for precise execution and decision-making, limiting interpretability and scalability. Here, we introduce human-artificial intelligence (AI) co-embodied intelligence, a new form of physical AI that unites human researchers, agentic AI, and wearable hardware. In this paradigm, humans provide precise execution, while agentic AI contributes contextual reasoning, adaptive planning, and analysis. The wearable interface continuously captures experimentation and manufacturing, facilitating seamless communication between humans and AI. We instantiate this paradigm in a microfabrication cleanroom, leading to the agentic-physical experimentation (APEX) system which understands fabrication procedure with accuracy 51% higher than state-of-the-art multimodal large language models/vision language models (LLMs/VLMs), detects and corrects fabrication errors in real-time, and transfers procedural expertise to novice users. Critically, APEX system enables the co-development of fabrication protocols in cleanrooms, overcoming the incompatibility of elastomeric materials in standard microfabrication processes and enabling previously unattainable fabrication outcomes, as demonstrated by the wafer-scale realization of brain-level soft neural probe capable of single-unit-resolution neural recording. These results establish the human-AI co-embodied intelligence that extends agentic reasoning beyond computation into the physical domain, transforming scientific experimentation and manufacturing into autonomous, traceable, interpretable and scalable processes.
summary_zh: 科学实验和制造依赖于漫长的协议开发和复杂的多步骤实施，这需要持续的人工专业知识来进行精确执行和决策，从而限制了解释性和可扩展性。在此，我们介绍了人-人工智能（AI）共生智能，一种新型的物理AI，它将人类研究者、自主型AI和可穿戴硬件结合起来。在这种模式中，人类提供精确的执行，而自主型AI则贡献上下文推理、自适应规划和分析。可穿戴界面持续捕获实验和制造过程，促进人类和AI之间的无缝通信。我们在微制造洁净室中实例化了这种模式，产生了自主型-物理实验（APEX）系统，该系统对制造程序的理解准确率比最先进的多模态大型语言模型/视觉语言模型（LLMs/VLMs）高出51%，能够实时检测和纠正制造错误，并将程序专业知识转移给新手用户。至关重要的是，APEX系统能够在洁净室中协同开发制造协议，克服了标准微制造工艺中弹性体材料的不相容性，并实现了以前无法达到的制造结果，如通过晶圆级实现能够进行单单元分辨率神经记录的脑级软神经探针所证明的那样。这些结果确立了人-AI共生智能，它将自主型推理从计算扩展到物理领域，将科学实验和制造转化为自主、可追溯、可解释和可扩展的过程。
tldr: This paper introduces human-AI co-embodied intelligence, specifically APEX, a system combining human expertise with AI reasoning and wearable interfaces for scientific experimentation and manufacturing, achieving improved accuracy and novel fabrication outcomes in a microfabrication cleanroom.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种人机共生智能，即 APEX 系统，它结合了人类的专业知识、人工智能推理和可穿戴界面，用于科学实验和制造。该系统在微制造洁净室中实现了更高的精度和新颖的制造结果。

title: Simulating Environments with Reasoning Models for Agent Training
summary: LLM agents excel in compact environments requiring deep reasoning but remain brittle when operating in broader, more complex contexts that demand robustness across diverse tools and schemas. Building bespoke environments for training is heavy, brittle, and limits progress. In this paper, we demonstrate that LLMs can simulate realistic environment feedback without access to actual testbed data or APIs. Inspired by this capability, we propose two frameworks: Simia-SFT, a pipeline that synthesizes SFT data by amplifying small seed sets into diverse trajectories in an environment-agnostic manner, and Simia-RL, a framework that enables RL training without real environment implementations through LLM-simulated feedback. Fine-tuning open models yields consistent improvements across multiple benchmarks, surpassing GPT-4o and approaching o4-mini on $τ^2$-Bench. Together, Simia-SFT and Simia-RL enable scalable agent training without environment engineering, replacing heavy and brittle implementations with flexible LLM-based simulation.
summary_zh: LLM智能体在需要深度推理的紧凑环境中表现出色，但在更广泛、更复杂的环境中运行时仍然脆弱，这些环境需要跨越不同工具和模式的鲁棒性。构建用于训练的定制环境既繁重又脆弱，并限制了进展。在本文中，我们证明了LLM可以在无需访问实际测试台数据或API的情况下模拟真实的环境反馈。受此能力的启发，我们提出了两个框架：Simia-SFT，一个通过以环境无关的方式将小型种子集合放大为多样化轨迹来合成SFT数据的流水线；以及Simia-RL，一个通过LLM模拟的反馈来实现无需真实环境实现的RL训练的框架。对开放模型进行微调可以在多个基准测试中产生一致的改进，超越GPT-4o，并在$τ^2$-Bench上接近o4-mini。总而言之，Simia-SFT和Simia-RL实现了无需环境工程的可扩展智能体训练，用灵活的基于LLM的模拟取代了繁重而脆弱的实现。
tldr: This paper introduces Simia-SFT and Simia-RL, frameworks using LLMs to simulate environment feedback for agent training, achieving performance improvements and reducing reliance on real-world environments.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了Simia-SFT和Simia-RL，这两个框架使用LLM来模拟环境反馈以进行智能体训练，从而提高了性能并减少了对真实环境的依赖。

title: Multimodal Reasoning via Latent Refocusing
summary: Chain of Thought (CoT) reasoning enhances logical performance by decomposing complex tasks, yet its multimodal extension faces a trade-off.
